label: Exceptional
description: Cleaned almost daily. A quick refresh.

label: Average
description: Comfortably lived in. Light soap scum. A deep clean may fit better.

label: Moderate
description: Pets or kids. Moderate bathroom or kitchen buildup.

label: Fallen Behind
description: Noticeable buildup in bathrooms and kitchen.

label: Challenging
description: Heavy dust, soap scum, or kitchen buildup. Detailed scrubbing is needed.

label: Maximum Challenge
description: Intensive detailing throughout. Some floors may need multiple passes.

label: Specialist
description: Biohazard, hoarding, pest waste, or unsafe conditions require a qualified specialist.
